parts.part_stem:
A copper wire of length $4.0 \text{ m}$ has a uniform cross-sectional area of $4.5 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m}^2$.

A tensile force of $18 \text{ N}$ is applied to the wire. This causes the wire to extend by $1.4 \text{ mm}$ up to its limit of proportionality.
parts.text: Calculate the Young modulus of the wire.
